notes: «حدثني أبي» (the compiler's shaykh's father) and «سمعت أبي» are bare fathers, relation links (rule 7); they are the two occurrences of أبي.
«جماعة» and «رجل» are unnamed transmitters (rule 8). «أخبرني رجل» is a gap, not filled.
The blessings «(ع)» and the Imam's epithet are left out. «علي بن الحسين» appears twice in the text: level 1 and the level-8 name «علي بن الحسين بن علي» are separate names.
